title: The Elder Scrolls' most obscure adventure gets a 4K PC makeover
gist: Shadowkey: Reforged is a free fan-made PC/Mac/Android port of the 2004 N-Gage RPG The Elder Scrolls Travels: Shadowkey, upscaled to 4K using original game files; its author says AI helped write the engine and create most of the new artwork. A light gaming piece with an AI-assisted development angle.

insights.claim: Shadowkey: Reforged, a free fan-made port of the 2004 N-Gage game The Elder Scrolls Travels: Shadowkey, runs natively on PC in 4K at up to 120 fps without an emulator, using the original game files.
insights.speaker: Kyle Orland
insights.so_what: Shows fan communities reviving obscure IP with modern tooling.

insights.claim: Reforged author Dan Whelan says he used AI to assist with coding, building the engine and debugging, and to create most of the modern higher-resolution artwork.
insights.speaker: Kyle Orland
insights.so_what: AI tools are lowering the cost of solo game ports and remasters.
